title: ClueCon 2026
html:
The next edition ClueCon Conference, the event organized by the developers of FreeSwitch, takes place in Chicago, USA, during August 11-13, 2026.

Again many Kamailio developers and community members are attending the event, a couple of them sharing their knowledge and experiences in the real time communications space, among them:

  • Alex Balashov
  • Daniel-Constantin Mierla
  • Julien Chavanton
  • Fred Posner

For more details about the event and its schedule, visit the website:

  • https://www.cluecon.com

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
